source.text: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְאָ֫סָ֥ףאֵ֤ל׀אֱֽלֹהִ֡ים יְֽהוָ֗ה דִּבֶּ֥ר וַיִּקְרָא־אָ֑רֶץ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֝֗מֶשׁ עַד־מְבֹאֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: A psalm of Asaph. [The] Mighty One, God, YHWH, has spoken and summoned [the] earth from [the] rising of [the] sun to its setting.

en.L: A psalm of Asaph. \q [The] Mighty One, God, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q has spoken and summoned [the] earth from the rising of [the] sun to its setting.
en.B: A psalm of Asaph. \q The Mighty One, God, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, has spoken; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has called to the whole earth, from the sunrise to the sunset.
en.R: A song of Asaph. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the mighty God, has spoken. \q He calls everyone on earth, from the far east to the far west.

fr.L: Un psaume d’Asaph. \q [Le] Puissant, Dieu, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q a parlé et a convoqué [la] terre, du lever du soleil jusqu’à son coucher.
fr.B: Un psaume d’Asaph. \q Le Puissant, Dieu, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, a parlé ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a appelé la terre entière, du soleil levant au soleil couchant.
fr.R: Un chant d’Asaph. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu puissant, a parlé. \q Il appelle tous les habitants de la terre, de l’extrême orient à l’extrême occident.

sw.L: Zaburi ya Asafu. \q Mwenye Nguvu, Mungu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q amenena na kuiita dunia tangu maawio ya jua hadi machweo yake.
sw.B: Zaburi ya Asafu. \q Mwenye Nguvu, Mungu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q amesema; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ameiita dunia yote, \q tangu jua linapochomoza hadi linapotua.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Asafu. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu mwenye nguvu, amesema. \q Anawaita watu wote duniani, \q kutoka mashariki ya mbali hadi magharibi ya mbali.

es.L: Un salmo de Asaf. \q [El] Poderoso, Dios, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q ha hablado y ha convocado a [la] tierra desde la salida del sol hasta su ocaso.
es.B: Un salmo de Asaf. \q El Poderoso, Dios, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ha hablado; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha llamado a toda la tierra, desde donde sale el sol hasta donde se pone.
es.R: Un canto de Asaf. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios poderoso, ha hablado. \q Llama a todos los que viven en la tierra, desde el lejano oriente hasta el lejano occidente.

vi.L: [Một] thi thiên của A-sáp. \q Đấng Quyền Năng, Đức Chúa Trời, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán và triệu tập đất từ nơi mặt trời mọc đến nơi nó lặn.
vi.B: Thi thiên của A-sáp. \q Đấng Quyền Năng, Đức Chúa Trời, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, đã phán; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã gọi cả trái đất, \q từ phương mặt trời mọc đến phương mặt trời lặn.
vi.R: Bài ca của A-sáp. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời quyền năng, đã phán. \q Ngài gọi mọi người trên đất, \q từ tận phương đông đến tận phương tây.

ko.L: 아삽의 시. \q 능하신 분, 하나님, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하시고, 해 뜨는 곳에서부터 해 지는 곳까지 땅을 부르셨다.
ko.B: 아삽의 시. \q 능하신 분, 하나님, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. \q 해 뜨는 데서부터 해 지는 데까지 온 땅을 부르셨다.
ko.R: 아삽이 지은 노래. \q 능력 있는 하나님, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 말씀하셨다. \q 동쪽 끝에서 \q 서쪽 끝까지 땅 위의 모든 사람을 부르신다.

pt.L: Salmo de Asafe. \q [O] Poderoso, Deus, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q falou e convocou [a] terra desde o nascer do sol até o seu ocaso.
pt.B: Salmo de Asafe. \q O Poderoso, Deus, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, falou; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} chamou toda a terra, do nascer ao pôr do sol.
pt.R: Canção de Asafe. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus poderoso, falou. \q Ele chama todos na terra, do extremo leste ao extremo oeste.

am.L: የአሳፍ መዝሙር። \q ኃያሉ፣ አምላክ፣ \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናገረ፤ ምድርንም ከፀሐይ መውጫ እስከ መግቢያዋ ጠራ።
am.B: የአሳፍ መዝሙር። \q ኃያሉ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናገረ፤ \q ከፀሐይ መውጫ እስከ ፀሐይ \q መግቢያ ድረስ ምድርን ሁሉ ጠራ።
am.R: አሳፍ የዘመረው መዝሙር። \q ኃያሉ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ተናግሯል። \q ከሩቁ ምሥራቅ እስከ ሩቁ ምዕራብ በምድር ያሉትን ሁሉ ይጠራል።

hi.L: आसाप का भजन। \q सामर्थी, परमेश्वर, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने कहा है \q और सूर्य के उदय से उसके अस्त होने तक पृथ्वी को बुलाया है।
hi.B: आसाप का भजन। \q सामर्थी परमेश्वर, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, बोले हैं; \q उन्होंने सूर्योदय से सूर्यास्त तक सारी पृथ्वी को पुकारा है।
hi.R: आसाप का गीत। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, जो सामर्थी परमेश्वर हैं, बोले हैं। \q वे पृथ्वी पर सब लोगों को बुलाते हैं, दूर पूरब से दूर पश्चिम तक।

ru.L: Псалом Асафа. \q Сильный, Бог, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, сказал \q и призвал землю от восхода солнца до заката его.
ru.B: Псалом Асафа. \q Сильный, Бог, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, заговорил; \q {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} призвал всю землю от восхода солнца до заката.
ru.R: Песнь Асафа. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, могучий Бог, заговорил. Он зовёт всех на земле, \q от дальнего востока до дальнего запада.

ja.L: アサフの賛歌。 \q 力ある方、神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語り、日の昇る所から沈む所まで、 \q 地を呼び寄せられた。
ja.B: アサフの賛歌。 \q 力ある方、神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語られた。 \q 日の出る所から日の入る所まで、全地に呼びかけられた。
ja.R: アサフの歌。 \q 力ある神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が語られた。その方は、東の果てから西の果てまで、 \q 地上のすべての人を呼び寄せられる。

uk.L: Псалом Асафа. \q Могутній, Бог, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, заговорив \q і скликав землю від сходу сонця до його заходу.
uk.B: Псалом Асафа. \q Могутній, Бог, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, заговорив; \q {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} покликав усю землю від сходу сонця до заходу.
uk.R: Пісня Асафа. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}, могутній Бог, заговорив. Він кличе всіх на землі, \q від далекого сходу до далекого заходу.

id.L: [Sebuah] mazmur Asaf. \q Yang Mahakuasa, Allah, {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, \q telah berfirman dan memanggil bumi dari terbitnya matahari sampai terbenamnya.
id.B: Mazmur Asaf. \q Yang Mahakuasa, Allah, {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, telah berfirman; \q {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} telah memanggil seluruh bumi, dari matahari terbit sampai matahari terbenam.
id.R: Lagu pujian karangan Asaf. \q {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah yang mahakuasa, telah berfirman. \q Dia memanggil semua orang di bumi, dari ujung timur sampai ujung barat.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: Asaph: a leader of the temple singers
decisions.reason: Asaph was a Levite whom David appointed to lead the singing before the ark (1 Chronicles 16:5-7); his family carried on the work. Psalms 50 and 73-83 bear his name.

decisions.choice: the Mighty One, God, YHWH: three names
decisions.reason: The psalm opens with three names of God one after another ('El, 'Elohim, YHWH), as in Joshua 22:22, to present him in full majesty as the judge who calls the court to order.

decisions.choice: has spoken and summoned the earth: God calls a trial
decisions.reason: God summons the whole world as his court to hear a case against his own people (verse 4), as the prophets do (Isaiah 1:2; Micah 6:1-2).

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1.

decisions.choice: "le Puissant" for El
decisions.reason: The psalm opens with three names of God (meaning decision m3). French keeps three distinct words: "le Puissant" for El, "Dieu" for Elohim and the divine name.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Quyền Năng, Đức Chúa Trời, CHÚA" for the three names
decisions.reason: The verse heaps up three names of God (see the meaning decision); "Đấng Quyền Năng" (the Mighty One) gives El its own word so that the three stay three.

decisions.choice: "phán" for God speaking
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "phán" for God speaking and "nói" for everyone else.

decisions.choice: "아삽" for Asaph; "능하신 분" (L, B) and "능력 있는 하나님" (R) for El, the Mighty One
decisions.reason: Names take their usual Protestant form (terms note). The three names of God stand together (meaning decision m3); Korean gives El as a title, keeping "하나님" for Elohim and the divine_name span for YHWH.

decisions.choice: Asafe
decisions.reason: The Brazilian form of the singer's name, as in the Portuguese of 1 Chronicles 16:5-7, where David appoints him; Psalms 73-83 use it too.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Amharic
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the English setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; the Amharic text has no deity_pronoun spans.

decisions.choice: the three names ('El, 'Elohim, YHWH) as "ኃያሉ፣ አምላክ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" (Literal), "ኃያሉ አምላክ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}" (Balanced, Readable); Asaph "አሳፍ" as 1 Chronicles 16
decisions.reason: Where Elohim stands beside the divine name, it is "አምላክ", so that the default reading does not say "እግዚአብሔር" twice; 'El, "the Mighty One", is "ኃያሉ".

decisions.choice: आसाप; सामर्थी, परमेश्वर, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}
decisions.reason: Asaph, leader of the temple singers, is आसाप, as in 1 Chronicles. The psalm opens with three names of God: El, "the Mighty One" (सामर्थी), Elohim (परमेश्वर) and the name YHWH (प्रभु, with the divine_name setting). Readable joins the first two, as the English does. Mizmor is भजन at Literal and Balanced and गीत at Readable, as in the titles.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans, as in English
decisions.reason: Hindi has no capital letters; God is set apart by honorific forms (उन्होंने, वे) in the third person, and God speaking uses मैं, so the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans in this psalm.

decisions.choice: "Псалом Асафа" (L, B); "Песнь Асафа" (R)
decisions.reason: Mizmor as the poetry note gives it; Asaph has the form of 1 Chronicles (Асаф), the leader of the temple singers (m2).

decisions.choice: "Сильный, Бог, ГОСПОДЬ"
decisions.reason: Three names of God in a row (m3): El as "Сильный", Elohim as "Бог", and the divine name under its setting. Readable joins the first two as "могучий Бог", as the English does.

decisions.choice: mizmor le'Asaf "アサフの賛歌" (L, B), "アサフの歌" (R); 'El 'Elohim YHWH "力ある方、神、DN" (L, B), "力ある神、DN" (R)
decisions.reason: The Psalter's title forms (PSA-1); three names for God (m3), 'El as "力ある方" where it stands as a name beside Elohim.

decisions.choice: "Асаф" for Asaph, through the book
decisions.reason: The Levite singer's name is transcribed from the Hebrew, as for the other names in the superscriptions.

decisions.choice: "Asaf"; "Yang Mahakuasa, Allah, TUHAN" for "El, Elohim, YHWH"
decisions.reason: "Asaf" is the glossary form. The three names of God stand side by side; "Yang Mahakuasa" for El here follows the English "Mighty One", though the glossary keeps it for Shaddai. A reviewer may prefer "Yang Mahaperkasa".

source.text: מִצִּיּ֥וֹן מִכְלַל־יֹ֗פִי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הוֹפִֽיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: From Zion, [the] perfection of beauty, God has shone forth.

en.L: From Zion, the perfection of beauty, \q God has shone forth.
en.B: God has blazed out from Zion, \q the city of flawless beauty.
en.R: God shines out like the sun from Zion, \q the most beautiful city.

fr.L: De Sion, la perfection de la beauté, \q Dieu a resplendi.
fr.B: Dieu a jailli dans sa lumière depuis Sion, \q la ville d’une beauté parfaite.
fr.R: Dieu brille comme le soleil depuis Sion, \q la plus belle des villes.

sw.L: Kutoka Sayuni, ukamilifu wa uzuri, \q Mungu ameangaza.
sw.B: Mungu ameng'aa kwa nguvu kutoka Sayuni, \q mji wa uzuri usio na kasoro.
sw.R: Mungu anang'aa kama jua kutoka Sayuni, \q mji ulio mzuri kuliko yote.

es.L: Desde Sion, la perfección de la hermosura, \q Dios ha resplandecido.
es.B: Dios ha brillado con fuerza desde Sion, \q la ciudad de belleza perfecta.
es.R: Dios brilla como el sol desde Sion, \q la ciudad más hermosa.

vi.L: Từ Si-ôn, sự hoàn mỹ của vẻ đẹp, \q Đức Chúa Trời đã chiếu sáng.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời đã rực sáng từ Si-ôn, \q thành đẹp đẽ tuyệt vời.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời chiếu sáng như mặt trời từ Si-ôn, \q thành đẹp nhất.

ko.L: 아름다움의 완성인 시온에서 하나님께서 \q 빛을 비추셨다.
ko.B: 더없이 아름다운 성 시온에서 하나님께서 \q 빛을 발하셨다.
ko.R: 가장 아름다운 성 시온에서 하나님께서 \q 해처럼 빛을 비추신다.

pt.L: De Sião, a perfeição da beleza, \q Deus resplandeceu.
pt.B: Deus brilhou com fulgor desde Sião, \q a cidade de beleza perfeita.
pt.R: Deus brilha como o sol a partir de Sião, \q a cidade mais bonita.

am.L: የውበት ፍጻሜ ከሆነችው ከጽዮን \q እግዚአብሔር አበራ።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር እንከን የሌለው ውበት ካላት \q ከተማ ከጽዮን ደምቆ ወጣ።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ከሁሉ ይልቅ \q ውብ ከሆነችው ከተማ ከጽዮን እንደ ፀሐይ ያበራል።

hi.L: सिय्योन से, जो सुंदरता की परिपूर्णता है, \q परमेश्वर ने अपना तेज चमकाया है।
hi.B: परमेश्वर सिय्योन से, उस निर्दोष सुंदरता के नगर से, \q प्रकाशमान हुए हैं।
hi.R: परमेश्वर सिय्योन से, जो सबसे सुंदर नगर है, \q सूर्य के समान चमकते हैं।

ru.L: С Сиона, совершенства красоты, \q Бог воссиял.
ru.B: Бог засиял с Сиона, \q города безупречной красоты.
ru.R: Бог сияет, как солнце, с Сиона, \q самого прекрасного города.

ja.L: 美しさの極みであるシオンから、 \q 神は光を放たれた。
ja.B: 完全な美しさをもつ都シオンから、 \q 神は輝き出られた。
ja.R: 最も美しい都シオンから、 \q 神は太陽のように輝き出られる。

uk.L: Із Сіону, досконалості краси, \q Бог засяяв.
uk.B: Бог засяяв із Сіону, \q міста бездоганної краси.
uk.R: Бог сяє, як сонце, із Сіону, \q найпрекраснішого міста.

id.L: Dari Sion, kesempurnaan keindahan, \q Allah telah bersinar.
id.B: Allah telah bersinar dari Sion, \q kota yang sempurna keindahannya.
id.R: Allah bersinar seperti matahari dari Sion, \q kota yang paling indah.

decisions.choice: shone forth: God appears in light
decisions.reason: The verb (yafa') is used for God's appearing in brightness, as when he came from Sinai and "shone forth from Mount Paran" (Deuteronomy 33:2; compare 80:2).

decisions.choice: the perfection of beauty: Zion
decisions.reason: The phrase describes Zion, as in Lamentations 2:15. God now comes not from Sinai but from Zion, where he lives.

decisions.choice: like the sun
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture of God's shining plain.

decisions.choice: hofia' "光を放たれた" (L), "輝き出られた" (B, R); mikhlal-yofi "美しさの極み" (L)
decisions.reason: God appears in light (m1); Zion, the perfection of beauty (m2).

source.text: יָ֤בֹ֥א אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וְֽאַל־יֶ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ אֵשׁ־לְפָנָ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּ֝סְבִיבָ֗יו נִשְׂעֲרָ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: Our God comes, and let him not keep silent; fire before him devours, and around him it storms exceedingly.

en.L: Our God comes and does not keep silent; \q fire devours before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} it storms exceedingly.
en.B: Our God is coming, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not stay silent; \q a fire consumes all in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} path, \q and a fierce storm rages on every side.
en.R: Our God is coming, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will not be quiet. \q Fire burns up everything in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q A terrible storm blows all around {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Notre Dieu vient et ne se tait pas ; \q un feu dévore devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, \q et autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} la tempête fait rage.
fr.B: Notre Dieu vient, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne restera pas silencieux ; \q un feu dévore tout sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} passage, \q et une violente tempête souffle de tous côtés.
fr.R: Notre Dieu arrive, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne restera pas muet. \q Le feu brûle tout devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Une terrible tempête souffle tout autour de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Mungu wetu anakuja wala hanyamazi; \q moto unateketeza mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, \q na pande zote {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} kuna dhoruba kali mno.
sw.B: Mungu wetu anakuja, wala {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hatanyamaza; \q moto unateketeza kila kitu njiani {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}, \q na tufani kali inavuma pande zote.
sw.R: Mungu wetu anakuja, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hatakaa kimya. \q Moto unateketeza kila kitu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Dhoruba ya kutisha inavuma pande zote {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.

es.L: Nuestro Dios viene y no calla; \q fuego consume delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, \q y alrededor de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hay gran tempestad.
es.B: Nuestro Dios viene, y no se quedará callado; \q un fuego lo consume todo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} paso, \q y una tormenta furiosa ruge a su alrededor.
es.R: Nuestro Dios viene, y no se quedará callado. \q El fuego quema todo lo que tiene delante. \q Una tormenta terrible sopla a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} alrededor.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đến và không im lặng; \q lửa thiêu nuốt trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và chung quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bão tố dữ dội.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đang đến, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không im lặng; \q lửa thiêu đốt mọi thứ trên đường {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi, \q và bão tố dữ dội nổi lên khắp chung quanh.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta đang đến, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ không im lặng. \q Lửa thiêu rụi mọi thứ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Một cơn bão khủng khiếp thổi quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 우리 하나님께서 오시니 잠잠하지 않으신다. \q 그분 앞에서 불이 삼키고, \q 그분 주위에는 폭풍이 몹시 휘몰아친다.
ko.B: 우리 하나님께서 오고 계시니, 잠잠히 계시지 않으실 것이다. \q 불이 그분 앞길을 삼키고, \q 사나운 폭풍이 사방에서 몰아친다.
ko.R: 우리 하나님께서 오신다. 그분은 조용히 계시지 않으실 것이다. \q 그분 앞에서 불이 모든 것을 태우고, \q 무서운 폭풍이 그분 둘레에 몰아친다.

pt.L: O nosso Deus vem e não fica calado; \q um fogo devora diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, \q e ao redor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} a tempestade se agita com força.
pt.B: O nosso Deus está vindo, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não vai ficar em silêncio; \q um fogo consome tudo no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} caminho, \q e uma tempestade violenta se agita por todos os lados.
pt.R: O nosso Deus está chegando, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} não vai ficar quieto. \q O fogo queima tudo o que está na frente {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. \q Uma tempestade terrível sopra ao redor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.

am.L: አምላካችን ይመጣል፤ ዝምም አይልም፤ \q እሳት በፊቱ ይበላል፤ \q በዙሪያውም አውሎ ነፋስ እጅግ ይነፍሳል።
am.B: አምላካችን ይመጣል፤ ዝም አይልም፤ \q በፊቱ ያለውን ሁሉ እሳት ይበላል፤ \q በዙሪያውም ብርቱ አውሎ ነፋስ ይነፍሳል።
am.R: አምላካችን ይመጣል፤ ዝም አይልም። \q በፊቱ ያለውን ሁሉ እሳት ያቃጥላል። \q በዙሪያው አስፈሪ አውሎ ነፋስ ይነፍሳል።

hi.L: हमारे परमेश्वर आते हैं और चुप नहीं रहते; \q उनके आगे आग भस्म करती है, \q और उनके चारों ओर बड़ी आँधी चलती है।
hi.B: हमारे परमेश्वर आ रहे हैं, और वे चुप न रहेंगे; \q उनके मार्ग में आग सब कुछ भस्म कर देती है, \q और चारों ओर प्रचंड आँधी उठती है।
hi.R: हमारे परमेश्वर आ रहे हैं, और वे चुप नहीं रहेंगे। \q उनके सामने आग सब कुछ जला देती है। \q उनके चारों ओर भयानक आँधी चलती है।

ru.L: Идёт Бог наш и не молчит; \q огонь пожирает перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, \q и вокруг {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} сильная буря.
ru.B: Наш Бог идёт, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не будет молчать; \q огонь пожирает всё на {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} пути, \q и вокруг бушует сильная буря.
ru.R: Наш Бог идёт, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не будет молчать. \q Огонь сжигает всё перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}. \q Страшная буря бушует вокруг {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}}.

ja.L: わたしたちの神は来られ、沈黙なさらない。 \q その方の前で火が焼き尽くし、 \q その周りでは激しく嵐が吹き荒れる。
ja.B: わたしたちの神は来られる。決して沈黙なさらない。 \q その方の行く手では、火がすべてを焼き尽くし、 \q 周りでは激しい嵐が荒れ狂う。
ja.R: わたしたちの神が来られる。その方は、黙っていることはなさらない。 \q その方の前では、火がすべてを焼き尽くす。 \q その方の周りでは、恐ろしい嵐が吹き荒れる。

uk.L: Наш Бог приходить і не мовчить; \q вогонь пожирає перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}, \q і довкола {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}} вельми бурхливо.
uk.B: Наш Бог іде, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} не мовчатиме; \q вогонь пожирає все на {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} шляху, \q і люта буря шаліє з усіх боків.
uk.R: Наш Бог іде, і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} не мовчатиме. \q Вогонь спалює все перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}. \q Страшна буря віє довкола {{deity_pronoun:нього|Нього}}.

id.L: Allah kita datang dan tidak berdiam diri; \q api menghanguskan di depan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, \q dan di sekeliling-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} badai mengamuk dengan dahsyat.
id.B: Allah kita datang, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} tidak akan tinggal diam; \q api menghanguskan segala sesuatu di jalan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}, \q dan badai yang dahsyat mengamuk di sekeliling-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.
id.R: Allah kita datang, dan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} tidak akan diam. \q Api membakar habis segala sesuatu di depan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}. \q Badai yang mengerikan bertiup di sekeliling-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.

decisions.choice: fire and storm: as at Sinai
decisions.reason: Fire and storm came with God when he gave the covenant at Sinai (Exodus 19:16-18). He comes in the same way to call his people to account for it.

decisions.choice: does not keep silent: he will speak
decisions.reason: The form can be a statement or a wish. The silence that ends here is the one of verse 21, which the wicked mistook for approval.

decisions.choice: 'al-yecherash "沈黙なさらない" (L, B), "黙っていることはなさらない" (R)
decisions.reason: He will speak (m2); God's negated act as お〜にならない / 〜なさらない, not 黙ってはおられない, which can read "cannot keep silent" (PSA-1).

source.text: יִקְרָ֣א אֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם מֵעָ֑ל וְאֶל־הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ לָדִ֥ין עַמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: He summons the heavens from above and the earth, to judge his people:

en.L: He summons the heavens above, \q and the earth, to judge {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people:
en.B: He calls heaven above and earth below as witnesses, \q as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} judges {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people:
en.R: He calls the sky and the earth to be witnesses \q while {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} judges {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.

fr.L: Il convoque les cieux d’en haut, \q et la terre, pour juger {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple :
fr.B: Il appelle le ciel en haut et la terre en bas comme témoins, \q pour juger {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple :
fr.R: Il appelle le ciel et la terre à être témoins \q pendant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} juge {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.

sw.L: Anaziita mbingu zilizo juu, \q na dunia, ili awahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}:
sw.B: Anaziita mbingu zilizo juu na dunia iliyo chini kuwa mashahidi, \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anapowahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}:
sw.R: Anaziita mbingu na dunia ziwe mashahidi wakati {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anapowahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

es.L: Convoca a los cielos de arriba, \q y a la tierra, para juzgar a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo:
es.B: Llama como testigos al cielo de arriba y a la tierra de abajo, \q mientras juzga a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo:
es.R: Llama al cielo y a la tierra para que sean testigos \q mientras {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} juzga a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.

vi.L: Ngài triệu tập các tầng trời ở trên cao, \q và đất, để xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}:
vi.B: Ngài gọi trời trên cao và đất bên dưới làm chứng, \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}:
vi.R: Ngài gọi bầu trời và mặt đất làm chứng trong khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그분께서 위로 하늘을, 그리고 땅을 부르신다, \q 그분의 백성을 재판하시려고.
ko.B: 그분께서 자기 백성을 재판하시려고, \q 위로는 하늘을, 아래로는 땅을 증인으로 부르신다.
ko.R: 그분께서 자기 백성을 재판하시는 동안 하늘과 땅을 증인으로 부르신다.

pt.L: Ele convoca os céus lá de cima, \q e a terra, para julgar o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo:
pt.B: Ele chama o céu lá em cima e a terra aqui embaixo como testemunhas, \q enquanto julga o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo:
pt.R: Ele chama o céu e a terra para serem testemunhas \q enquanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} julga o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo.

am.L: ሕዝቡን ይፈርድ ዘንድ ሰማያትን ከላይ፣ \q ምድርንም ይጠራል፦
am.B: ሕዝቡን ሲፈርድ ላይ ያለውን ሰማይና ታች \q ያለውን ምድር ምስክሮች እንዲሆኑ ይጠራል፦
am.R: ሕዝቡን በሚፈርድበት ጊዜ ሰማይንና ምድርን ምስክሮች እንዲሆኑ ይጠራል።

hi.L: वे अपनी प्रजा का न्याय करने के लिए ऊपर के आकाश को \q और पृथ्वी को बुलाते हैं:
hi.B: अपनी प्रजा का न्याय करते \q समय वे ऊपर आकाश को और नीचे पृथ्वी को गवाह होने के लिए बुलाते हैं:
hi.R: वे अपनी प्रजा का न्याय करते समय आकाश \q और पृथ्वी को गवाह होने के लिए बुलाते हैं।

ru.L: Он призывает небеса свыше и землю, \q чтобы судить свой народ:
ru.B: Он призывает небо вверху и землю внизу в свидетели, \q когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} судит свой народ:
ru.R: Он зовёт небо и землю быть свидетелями, \q когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} судит свой народ.

ja.L: その方は上なる天と、地とを呼び寄せられる、 \q ご自分の民を裁くために。
ja.B: その方は、上なる天と下なる地を証人として呼び、 \q ご自分の民を裁かれる。
ja.R: その方は、天と地を証人として呼び、 \q ご自分の民を裁かれる。

uk.L: Він кличе небеса вгорі й землю, \q щоб судити {{deity_pronoun:свій|Свій}} народ:
uk.B: Він кличе небо вгорі й землю внизу за свідків, \q коли судить {{deity_pronoun:свій|Свій}} народ:
uk.R: Він кличе небо й землю бути свідками, \q поки {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} судить {{deity_pronoun:свій|Свій}} народ.

id.L: Dia memanggil langit di atas, \q dan bumi, untuk menghakimi umat-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}:
id.B: Dia memanggil langit di atas dan bumi di bawah sebagai saksi, \q ketika {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} menghakimi umat-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}:
id.R: Dia memanggil langit dan bumi untuk menjadi saksi \q ketika {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} menghakimi umat-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}}.

decisions.choice: heaven and earth: witnesses in court
decisions.reason: Heaven and earth were called as witnesses when the covenant was made (Deuteronomy 30:19; 32:1), and so they are called again when God brings his case.

decisions.choice: judge: hear the case of
decisions.reason: The verb (din) means to judge or plead a case. God judges his own people here, not the nations.

decisions.choice: as witnesses
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say why heaven and earth are called (m1).

decisions.choice: The colon of the English becomes the end of the sentence; God's words follow in 50:5 in their own 「」
decisions.reason: Heaven and earth are witnesses in court (m1), supplied at B and R as the English.

source.text: אִסְפוּ־לִ֥י חֲסִידָ֑י כֹּרְתֵ֖י בְרִיתִ֣י עֲלֵי־זָֽבַח׃

records.literal_gloss: Gather to me my faithful ones, those who cut my covenant over sacrifice.

en.L: "Gather to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} faithful ones, \q those who cut {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant by sacrifice."
en.B: "Bring together before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} loyal people, \q who sealed {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant with a sacrifice."
en.R: "Bring {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} faithful people to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q They made a covenant with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} by offering a sacrifice."

fr.L: « Rassemblez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} fidèles, \q ceux qui ont tranché {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance par un sacrifice. »
fr.B: « Réunissez devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple fidèle, \q qui a scellé {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance par un sacrifice. »
fr.R: « Amenez-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple fidèle. \q Ils ont fait alliance avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} en offrant un sacrifice. »

sw.L: "Wakusanyeni {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}} waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q wale waliokata agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kwa dhabihu."
sw.B: "Waleteni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} walio waaminifu, \q waliothibitisha agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} kwa dhabihu."
sw.R: "Waleteni watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. \q Walifanya agano {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} kwa kutoa dhabihu."

es.L: «{{plural_you:Reúnanme|Reunidme}} a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} fieles, \q los que hicieron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con sacrificio.»
es.B: «{{plural_you:Junten|Juntad}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo leal, \q los que sellaron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con un sacrificio.»
es.R: «{{plural_you:Tráiganme|Traedme}} a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo fiel. \q Ellos hicieron un pacto conmigo al ofrecer un sacrificio.»

vi.L: “Hãy nhóm họp cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} những người trung tín của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q những người đã kết ước với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng của lễ.”
vi.B: “Hãy tập hợp trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} dân trung thành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q là những người đã lập giao ước với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng của lễ.”
vi.R: “Hãy đem dân trung thành của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Họ đã lập giao ước với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng cách dâng của lễ.”

ko.L: “나에게 모아라, 나의 신실한 자들을, \q 제사로 나의 언약을 맺은 자들을.”

ru.L: «Соберите ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} верных, \q заключивших {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} завет жертвой.»

uk.L: «Зберіть до {{deity_pronoun:мене|Мене}} {{deity_pronoun:моїх|Моїх}} вірних, \q тих, хто уклав {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} завіт жертвою.»

id.L: "Kumpulkanlah kepada-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} orang-orang-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} yang saleh, \q yang mengikat perjanjian-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}} dengan korban."

decisions.choice: Gather to me: God speaks
decisions.reason: God gives the order to his court, so the words are in quotation marks. The psalm does not say who is told to gather the people.

decisions.choice: cut my covenant by sacrifice: Sinai
decisions.reason: A covenant was "cut" with a sacrifice; at Sinai Moses sprinkled the blood of the offerings on the altar and on the people (Exodus 24:5-8).

decisions.choice: my faithful ones: my loyal people
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is the one of 4:4 and 12:2, here for all of Israel, the people bound to God by covenant, whether or not they live up to the name.

decisions.choice: God's "moi", "me", "mon", "ma", "mes" follow the deity pronoun setting when God speaks; "je" has none
decisions.reason: As in the English, the pronouns God uses of himself can be capitalised as an option. French writes "je" plainly, as it does for Jesus in the Gospels, and puts the setting on the other forms.

decisions.choice: when God speaks, the deity pronoun span goes on the separate words for "me" and "my" ("kwangu|Kwangu", "wangu|Wangu", "nami|Nami"), not on "mimi" as the subject "I"
decisions.reason: The English capitalises every pronoun for God except "I". Swahili follows: its possessives and "kwangu" (to me) take the span, while "me" inside a verb ("niite") cannot, and the subject "mimi" is left plain as the English "I" is.

decisions.choice: "Ta" for God speaking, with the deity_pronoun setting in the middle of a sentence
decisions.reason: God speaks from here to verse 23. He says "Ta", as the style guide has God speak, and the setting stands on it in mid-sentence as on Jesus's "Ta" in John; at the start of a sentence it is capitalised either way.

decisions.choice: God speaks in 해라체 with "나", and calls Israel "너" (verses 5, 7-15, 16-23)
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a: God speaking uses 해라체 with 나. The quotation marks show where his speech begins and ends (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "cut my covenant" as "ቃል ኪዳኔን የገቡትን"
decisions.reason: Amharic makes a covenant with "ቃል ኪዳን ገባ"; the Hebrew "cut" pictures the sacrifice, which the line names, and a word-for-word "ቆረጠ" would not be understood.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on God's "я", "мне", "мой" through his speech (verses 5, 7-15, 16-23)
decisions.reason: God speaks (m1). As the style guide and the earlier books do, every pronoun for God takes the span, a mid-sentence "я" included; a sentence-initial "Я" is written plainly; the people addressed get none.

decisions.choice: God speaks plainly with 〜なさい; chasidai "わたしの誠実な者たち" (L), "わたしの誠実な人々" (B), "わたしに忠実な人々" (R)
decisions.reason: God's speech in the Psalter is plain (PSA-1); chasid by the Psalter's forms (m3). karat berit "契約を結ぶ", the Sinai covenant (m2).

decisions.choice: God himself is judge
alternatives: God is a God of justice
decisions.reason: The pronoun (hu') stresses that God himself sits in judgment; no lesser judge will hear this case.

decisions.choice: his righteousness: his justice as judge
decisions.reason: Righteousness (tsedeq) here is the fairness of the judge. The heavens, his witnesses, declare that his verdict will be just.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "Sê-la" kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The word's meaning is no longer known; it is probably a musical direction (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "сам" without a span
decisions.reason: The English capitalises "himself" under the setting; Russian "сам" takes none (style guide 7b).

decisions.choice: "Села" at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: As in 44:9: a word whose meaning is no longer known, kept at every level.

decisions.choice: tsidqo "その方の義" (L, B), "公平な方であること" (R); "神ご自身が" (every level)
decisions.reason: His justice as judge (m2); God himself is judge (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Hear, my people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will testify against you; God, your God, [am] I.

en.L: "Hear, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, and I will speak; \q Israel, and I will testify against you: \q God, your God, [am] I.
en.B: "Pay attention, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, for I am about to speak; \q I am bringing testimony against you, Israel. \q I am God, your God.
en.R: "Listen, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people! I am going to speak. \q Israel, I am telling you what you have done wrong. \q I am God, your God.

fr.L: « Écoute, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, et je parlerai ; \q Israël, et je témoignerai contre toi : \q Dieu, ton Dieu, [c’est] moi.
fr.B: « Sois attentif, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, car je vais parler ; \q je porte témoignage contre toi, Israël. \q Je suis Dieu, ton Dieu.
fr.R: « Écoute, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple ! Je vais parler. \q Israël, je vais te dire ce que tu as fait de mal. \q Je suis Dieu, ton Dieu.

sw.L: "Sikieni, watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, nami nitanena; \q Ee Israeli, nami nitashuhudia dhidi yako: \q Mungu, Mungu wako, [ni] mimi.
sw.B: "Sikilizeni, watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, kwa maana ninakaribia kusema; \q ninaleta ushahidi dhidi yako, Israeli. \q Mimi ni Mungu, Mungu wako.
sw.R: "Sikilizeni, watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}! Nitasema. \q Israeli, ninakuambia mabaya uliyoyatenda. \q Mimi ni Mungu, Mungu wako.

es.L: «Escucha, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, y hablaré; \q Israel, y testificaré contra ti: \q Dios, tu Dios, [soy] yo.
es.B: «Presta atención, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}, porque voy a hablar; \q traigo testimonio contra ti, Israel. \q Yo soy Dios, tu Dios.
es.R: «¡Escucha, pueblo {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}! Voy a hablar. \q Israel, te voy a decir lo que has hecho mal. \q Yo soy Dios, tu Dios.

vi.L: “Hãy nghe, hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phán; hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm chứng nghịch lại các con: Ta [là] Đức Chúa Trời, \q Đức Chúa Trời của các con.
vi.B: “Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy chú ý, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sắp phán; \q hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm chứng nghịch lại các con. Ta là Đức Chúa Trời, \q Đức Chúa Trời của các con.
vi.R: “Hỡi dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, hãy lắng nghe! Ta sắp phán. \q Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang nói cho các con biết những điều các con đã làm sai. \q Ta là Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Chúa Trời của các con.

ko.L: “들어라, 내 백성아, 내가 말하겠다. \q 이스라엘아, 내가 너에게 불리하게 증언하겠다. \q 하나님, 너의 하나님이 나[다].
ko.B: “내 백성아, 귀 기울여라. 내가 말하겠다. \q 이스라엘아, 내가 너를 고발하는 증언을 하겠다. \q 나는 하나님, 너의 하나님이다.
ko.R: “내 백성아, 들어라! 내가 말하겠다. \q 이스라엘아, 네가 잘못한 일을 내가 말해 주겠다. \q 나는 하나님, 너의 하나님이다.

pt.L: "Escuta, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, e eu falarei; \q Israel, e eu darei testemunho contra ti: \q Deus, o teu Deus, [sou] eu.
pt.B: "Presta atenção, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, porque vou falar; \q Israel, vou apresentar testemunho contra ti. \q Eu sou Deus, o teu Deus.
pt.R: "Escuta, {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo! Vou falar. \q Israel, vou te dizer o que fizeste de errado. \q Eu sou Deus, o teu Deus.

am.L: «ሕዝቤ ሆይ፣ ስማ፤ እኔም እናገራለሁ፤ \q እስራኤል ሆይ፣ በአንተ ላይ እመሰክራለሁ፤ \q እኔ እግዚአብሔር፣ አምላክህ ነኝ።
am.B: «ሕዝቤ ሆይ፣ ልብ በል፤ ልናገር ነው፤ \q እስራኤል ሆይ፣ በአንተ ላይ ምስክርነት አቀርባለሁ። \q እኔ እግዚአብሔር፣ አምላክህ ነኝ።
am.R: «ሕዝቤ ሆይ፣ ስማ! ልናገር ነው። \q እስራኤል ሆይ፣ ያጠፋኸውን እነግርሃለሁ። \q እኔ እግዚአብሔር፣ አምላክህ ነኝ።

hi.L: "हे मेरी प्रजा, सुनो, और मैं बोलूँगा; \q हे इस्राएल, मैं तुम्हारे विरुद्ध गवाही दूँगा: \q परमेश्वर, तुम्हारा परमेश्वर, मैं [हूँ]।
hi.B: "हे मेरी प्रजा, ध्यान दो, क्योंकि मैं बोलने पर हूँ; \q हे इस्राएल, मैं तुम्हारे विरुद्ध गवाही दे रहा हूँ। \q मैं परमेश्वर हूँ, तुम्हारा परमेश्वर।
hi.R: "हे मेरी प्रजा, सुनो! मैं बोलने जा रहा हूँ। \q हे इस्राएल, मैं तुम्हें बता रहा हूँ कि तुमने क्या-क्या ग़लत किया है। \q मैं परमेश्वर हूँ, तुम्हारा परमेश्वर।

ru.L: «Слушай, народ {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}}, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду говорить; \q Израиль, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} засвидетельствую против тебя: \q Бог, Бог твой — {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}}.
ru.B: «Слушай, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} буду говорить; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} свидетельствую против тебя, Израиль. \q Я — Бог, твой Бог.
ru.R: «Слушай, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ! Я буду говорить. \q Израиль, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} скажу тебе, что ты сделал не так. \q Я — Бог, твой Бог.

ja.L: 「聞きなさい、わたしの民よ。わたしは語ろう。イスラエルよ、わたしはあなたに対して証言しよう。 \q わたしは神、あなたの神である。
ja.B: 「わたしの民よ、よく聞きなさい。わたしは語る。イスラエルよ、わたしはあなたに対して証言する。 \q わたしは神、あなたの神である。
ja.R: 「わたしの民よ、聞きなさい！わたしは語る。イスラエルよ、わたしは、あなたがどんな悪いことをしたかを告げる。 \q わたしは神、あなたの神だ。

uk.L: «Слухай, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народе, і я говоритиму; Ізраїлю, і я свідчитиму проти тебе: \q Бог, твій Бог — я.
uk.B: «Зважай, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народе, бо я зараз говоритиму; я свідчу проти тебе, Ізраїлю. \q Я — Бог, твій Бог.
uk.R: «Слухай, {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}} народе! Я говоритиму. Ізраїлю, я кажу тобі, що ти зробив неправильно. \q Я — Бог, твій Бог.

id.L: "Dengarlah, hai umat-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan berfirman; \q hai Israel, dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan bersaksi melawan engkau: \q Allah, Allahmu, [adalah] {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}}.
id.B: "Perhatikanlah, hai umat-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, sebab {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan berfirman; \q {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} memberikan kesaksian melawan engkau, hai Israel. \q Akulah Allah, Allahmu.
id.R: "Dengarlah, hai umat-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}! Aku akan berbicara. \q Hai Israel, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} sedang memberitahukan kepadamu apa kesalahanmu. \q Akulah Allah, Allahmu.

decisions.choice: Hear, Israel ... I am God, your God
decisions.reason: The words echo the covenant: "Hear, Israel" (Deuteronomy 6:4) and "I am the LORD your God" at the head of the Ten Commandments (Exodus 20). Psalms 42-83 mostly say "God" where other psalms say "the LORD".

decisions.choice: testify against you: bring evidence as a witness
decisions.reason: The verb ('ud) means to bear witness or to warn solemnly. God is both judge and witness in this case.

decisions.choice: God's speech, to verse 15
decisions.reason: From here God speaks to his people to the end of verse 15; the quotation stays open until then.

decisions.choice: "[c'est] moi" at the end of the Literal line, with no setting
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ends with the stressed "I"; French says "c'est moi". It stands for God's "I", which takes no setting in French, as "je" does not.

decisions.choice: "Sikieni"/"Sikilizeni" (plural) to the people, then singular "you" ("dhidi yako", "dhabihu zako") for Israel through God's speech
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks to the people as one, "Israel". A call to listen is naturally plural in Swahili, while the charges that follow keep the singular of the Hebrew, addressed to Israel as one nation.

decisions.choice: "tú" for Israel, so no plural_you span
decisions.reason: God speaks to Israel in the singular, as one people, through verse 21, and Spanish keeps the singular "tú"; the plural_you setting has nothing to change. Verse 22 turns to the plural and takes the setting.

decisions.choice: "các con" for God's people addressed (7-15)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is Israel as one person. God speaks to his own people as a father would, even while he brings a charge; "các con" keeps that relation, where "ngươi" would sound archaic and cold.

decisions.choice: tu (God to Israel, addressed in the singular)
decisions.reason: God speaks to his people as one, in the singular ("my people", "Israel", "against you"), so he says "tu", as the Old Testament terms have God speak to Israel addressed in the singular; the same "tu" goes on to the wicked one in verses 16-21. Verse 22, addressed to a group in the plural, says "vocês".

decisions.choice: God addresses Israel in the singular ("ስማ", "አንተ") through the psalm; "God, your God, am I" as "እኔ እግዚአብሔር፣ አምላክህ ነኝ"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks to the people as one "you", as in "Hear, Israel" (Deuteronomy 6:4); the formula echoes "I am the LORD your God" of Exodus 20, here with Elohim, so it takes "እግዚአብሔር" with no divine_name span. Verse 22 alone turns to the plural ("you who forget God").

decisions.choice: तुम from God to his people
decisions.reason: God speaks to his people Israel, as in the Pentateuch, with तुम (सुनो, तुम्हारा), to the whole people and, from verse 16, to the wicked man; तू is kept for speech to God.

decisions.choice: God's speech opens with 「 here and closes with 」 at 50:15; Israel addressed as "あなた"
decisions.reason: The speech runs to 50:15 (m3), with the same quotation structure as the English; "Hear, Israel … I am God, your God" echoes the Shema and Sinai (m1).

decisions.choice: God to Israel: "engkau", "-mu" (L, B), "kamu" (R); "Aku" with the span
decisions.reason: Israel is addressed as one, in the singular, as the Hebrew has it; the forms are those the style guide sets for God speaking to one person. Verse 22 turns to a plural "kalian".

source.text: לֹ֣א עַל־זְ֭בָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶ֖יךָ לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: Not on your sacrifices do I rebuke you, and your burnt offerings [are] before me continually.

en.L: Not for your sacrifices do I rebuke you, \q and your burnt offerings [are] before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} continually.
en.B: I do not find fault with you over your sacrifices; \q your burnt offerings are always in front of {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: I am not angry at you because of your sacrifices. \q You always bring {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} burnt offerings.

fr.L: Ce n’est pas pour tes sacrifices que je te reprends, \q et tes holocaustes [sont] devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} continuellement.
fr.B: Je ne te fais pas de reproche pour tes sacrifices ; \q tes holocaustes sont toujours devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Je ne suis pas fâché contre toi à cause de tes sacrifices. \q Tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}apportes toujours des holocaustes.

sw.L: Sikukemei kwa ajili ya dhabihu zako, \q na sadaka zako za kuteketezwa [ziko] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} daima.
sw.B: Sikulaumu kwa sababu ya dhabihu zako; \q sadaka zako za kuteketezwa ziko mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} siku zote.
sw.R: Sikukasirikii kwa sababu ya dhabihu zako. \q Daima unaniletea sadaka za kuteketezwa.

es.L: No por tus sacrificios te reprendo, \q y tus holocaustos [están] delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} continuamente.
es.B: No te reprocho tus sacrificios; \q tus holocaustos están siempre delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.R: No estoy enojado contigo por tus sacrificios. \q Siempre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traes holocaustos.

vi.L: Không phải vì các của lễ của các con mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trách các con, \q và các của lễ thiêu của các con [vẫn ở] trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} luôn luôn.
vi.B: Ta không trách các con về các của lễ; \q các của lễ thiêu của các con vẫn luôn ở trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Ta không giận các con vì những của lễ các con dâng. \q Các con vẫn luôn dâng của lễ thiêu cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 너의 제물들 때문에 내가 너를 책망하는 것이 아니다. \q 너의 번제물들은 늘 내 앞에 [있다].
ko.B: 네가 바친 제물 때문에 너를 나무라는 것이 아니다. \q 너의 번제물은 언제나 내 앞에 있다.
ko.R: 네가 바친 제물 때문에 내가 너에게 화가 난 것이 아니다. \q 너는 늘 나에게 번제물을 가져온다.

pt.L: Não pelos teus sacrifícios te repreendo, \q e os teus holocaustos [estão] diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} continuamente.
pt.B: Não é pelos teus sacrifícios que te acuso; \q os teus holocaustos estão sempre diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.R: Não estou zangado contigo por causa dos teus sacrifícios. \q Tu sempre {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} trazes holocaustos.

am.L: ስለ መሥዋዕቶችህ አልዘልፍህም፤ \q የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶችህም ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ [ናቸው]።
am.B: ስለ መሥዋዕቶችህ አልወቅስህም፤ \q የሚቃጠሉ መሥዋዕቶችህ ሁልጊዜ በፊቴ ናቸው።
am.R: ስለ መሥዋዕቶችህ አልተቆጣሁህም። \q ሁልጊዜ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ታመጣልኛለህ።

hi.L: मैं तुम्हारे बलिदानों के कारण तुम्हें नहीं डाँटता, \q और तुम्हारे होमबलि नित्य मेरे सामने [हैं]।
hi.B: मैं तुम्हारे बलिदानों के विषय में तुम में दोष नहीं निकालता; \q तुम्हारे होमबलि सदा मेरे सामने रहते हैं।
hi.R: मैं तुम्हारे बलिदानों के कारण तुमसे नाराज़ नहीं हूँ। \q तुम सदा मेरे लिए होमबलि लाते हो।

ru.L: Не за жертвы твои {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} упрекаю тебя, \q и всесожжения твои передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}} всегда.
ru.B: Я не осуждаю тебя за твои жертвы; \q твои всесожжения всегда передо {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}.
ru.R: Я не сержусь на тебя из-за твоих жертв. \q Ты всегда приносишь {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} всесожжения.

ja.L: あなたのいけにえのことで、わたしはあなたを責めるのではない。 \q あなたの焼き尽くすささげ物は、絶えずわたしの前に[ある]。
ja.B: わたしは、あなたのいけにえのことで、あなたをとがめるのではない。 \q あなたの焼き尽くすささげ物は、いつもわたしの前にある。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたのささげ物のことで、怒っているのではない。 \q あなたは、いつもわたしに、焼いてささげるいけにえを持って来る。

uk.L: Не за твої жертви я докоряю тобі, \q і твої всепалення — переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}} завжди.
uk.B: Я не дорікаю тобі за твої жертви; \q твої всепалення завжди переді {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}.
uk.R: Я не гніваюся на тебе через твої жертви. \q Ти завжди приносиш {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}} всепалення.

id.L: Bukan karena korban-korbanmu {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} menegur engkau, \q dan korban-korban bakaranmu senantiasa [ada] di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.
id.B: Aku tidak mencela engkau karena korban-korbanmu; \q korban-korban bakaranmu selalu ada di hadapan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.
id.R: Aku tidak marah kepadamu karena korban-korbanmu. \q Kamu selalu membawa korban bakaran kepada-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.

decisions.choice: not for your sacrifices: the problem lies elsewhere
decisions.reason: God does not reject the sacrifices themselves; the people offer them faithfully. His complaint is about what they think sacrifice is (verses 9-13) and how they live (verses 16-21).

decisions.choice: burnt offerings, continually: the daily offering
decisions.reason: The burnt offering ('olah) was burned whole on the altar; one was offered every morning and evening (Exodus 29:38-42).

decisions.choice: zevach "いけにえ" (L, B), "ささげ物" (R); 'olah "焼き尽くすささげ物" (L, B), "焼いてささげるいけにえ" (R)
decisions.reason: The offering words of Leviticus and the Psalter (PSA-1); the daily offering (m2).

source.text: לֹא־אֶקַּ֣ח מִבֵּיתְךָ֣ פָ֑ר מִ֝מִּכְלְאֹתֶ֗יךָ עַתּוּדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Not I will take from your house a bull, from your folds goats.

en.L: I will not take a bull from your house, \q [or] goats from your folds.
en.B: I will not accept a young bull from your household, \q or male goats out of your sheepfolds.
en.R: I do not need to take a bull from your farm \q or goats from your flocks.

fr.L: Je ne prendrai pas de taureau dans ta maison, \q [ni] de boucs dans tes enclos.
fr.B: Je n’accepterai ni un jeune taureau de ta maison, \q ni des boucs de tes bergeries.
fr.R: Je n’ai pas besoin de prendre un taureau dans ta ferme, \q ni des boucs dans tes troupeaux.

sw.L: Sitachukua fahali kutoka nyumbani mwako, \q [wala] mbuzi kutoka mazizi yako.
sw.B: Sitapokea ndama dume kutoka nyumbani kwako, \q wala mabeberu kutoka mazizini mwako.
sw.R: Sihitaji kuchukua fahali kutoka shambani kwako wala mbuzi kutoka makundi yako.

es.L: No tomaré de tu casa un becerro, \q [ni] machos cabríos de tus rediles.
es.B: No aceptaré un novillo de tu casa, \q ni machos cabríos de tus corrales.
es.R: No necesito tomar un toro de tu granja \q ni cabras de tus rebaños.

vi.L: Ta sẽ không lấy một con bò đực từ nhà các con, \q [hay] những con dê đực từ chuồng các con.
vi.B: Ta sẽ không nhận một con bò tơ từ nhà các con, \q hay những con dê đực từ chuồng chiên các con.
vi.R: Ta không cần lấy một con bò từ trang trại các con, hay những con dê từ bầy của các con.

ko.L: 나는 너의 집에서 수소를, 너의 우리들에서 \q 숫염소들을 취하지 않겠다.
ko.B: 나는 네 집에서 수송아지를 받지 않고, \q 네 우리에서 숫염소를 받지 않겠다.
ko.R: 나는 네 농장에서 수소를 가져갈 필요도 없고, 네 가축 떼에서 염소를 가져갈 필요도 없다.

pt.L: Não tomarei da tua casa um novilho, \q [nem] bodes dos teus currais.
pt.B: Não aceitarei um novilho da tua casa, \q nem bodes dos teus apriscos.
pt.R: Não preciso tirar um touro do teu sítio \q nem bodes dos teus rebanhos.

am.L: ከቤትህ ወይፈንን፣ \q ከበረትህም ፍየሎችን አልወስድም።
am.B: ከቤትህ ወይፈንን፣ ከጉረኖዎችህም ተባዕት \q ፍየሎችን አልቀበልም።
am.R: ከእርሻህ በሬን፣ ከመንጋህም ፍየሎችን መውሰድ አያስፈልገኝም።

hi.L: मैं न तुम्हारे घर से बैल लूँगा, \q [न] तुम्हारे बाड़ों से बकरे।
hi.B: मैं न तुम्हारे घराने से कोई बछड़ा स्वीकार करूँगा, \q न तुम्हारी भेड़शालाओं से बकरे।
hi.R: मुझे तुम्हारे खेत से बैल \q या तुम्हारे झुंडों से बकरे लेने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।

ru.L: Не возьму {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} из дома твоего быка, \q из загонов твоих козлов.
ru.B: Я не приму молодого быка из твоего хозяйства \q или козлов из твоих загонов.
ru.R: Мне не нужно брать быка из твоего хозяйства \q или козлов из твоих стад.

ja.L: わたしは、あなたの家から雄牛を、 \q あなたの囲いから雄やぎを取らない。
ja.B: わたしは、あなたの家から若い雄牛を受け取ることも、 \q あなたの囲いから雄やぎを受け取ることもしない。
ja.R: わたしは、あなたの家畜小屋から雄牛を、あなたの群れからやぎを、 \q もらう必要はない。

uk.L: Я не візьму бичка з твого дому, \q [ані] козлів із твоїх кошар.
uk.B: Я не прийму молодого бичка з твого господарства \q чи козлів із твоїх кошар.
uk.R: Мені не треба брати бика з твого господарства \q чи козлів із твоїх отар.

id.L: Aku tidak akan mengambil lembu jantan dari rumahmu, \q [atau] kambing-kambing jantan dari kandang-kandangmu.
id.B: Aku tidak akan menerima lembu jantan muda dari rumahmu, \q atau kambing-kambing jantan dari kandang-kandangmu.
id.R: Aku tidak perlu mengambil sapi jantan dari ladangmu \q atau kambing-kambing dari kawanan ternakmu.

decisions.choice: I will not take: I have no need of them
decisions.reason: Verses 10-12 give the reason: God does not take the animals because he needs them; they are already his.

decisions.choice: bull, goats: animals for sacrifice
decisions.reason: The young bull (par) and the male goats ('attudim) were among the costliest offerings.

decisions.choice: "もらう必要はない" (R)
decisions.reason: I have no need of them (m1), as the English R.

source.text: כִּי־לִ֥י כָל־חַיְתוֹ־יָ֑עַר בְּ֝הֵמ֗וֹת בְּהַרְרֵי־אָֽלֶף׃

records.literal_gloss: For to me [belongs] every living thing of [the] forest, [the] animals on hills of a thousand.

en.L: For every living thing of [the] forest [is] {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}, \q the cattle on a thousand hills.
en.B: For all the creatures of the woods belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q and so do the herds grazing over a thousand hills.
en.R: All the wild animals in the forest belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q So do the cattle on thousands of hills.

fr.L: Car toute bête de [la] forêt [est] à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, \q le bétail sur mille collines.
fr.B: Car tous les animaux des bois {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent, \q ainsi que les troupeaux qui paissent sur mille collines.
fr.R: Tous les animaux sauvages de la forêt {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent. \q Le bétail sur des milliers de collines aussi.

sw.L: Kwa maana kila kiumbe hai cha msituni [ni] {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}}, \q wanyama juu ya vilima elfu.
sw.B: Kwa maana viumbe vyote vya mwituni ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q vivyo hivyo makundi ya ng'ombe yanayolisha juu ya vilima elfu.
sw.R: Wanyama wote wa porini ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. \q Vivyo hivyo ng'ombe walio juu ya maelfu ya vilima.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} [es] todo animal del bosque, \q el ganado sobre mil colinas.
es.B: Porque todas las criaturas del bosque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen, \q y también los rebaños que pastan en mil colinas.
es.R: Todos los animales salvajes del bosque {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen. \q También el ganado de miles de colinas.

vi.L: Vì mọi sinh vật của rừng [là] của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q cả bầy súc vật trên ngàn đồi.
vi.B: Vì mọi loài thú trong rừng đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và cả những đàn gia súc trên ngàn ngọn đồi cũng vậy.
vi.R: Mọi loài thú hoang trong rừng đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Cả gia súc trên hàng ngàn ngọn đồi cũng vậy.

ko.L: 이는 숲의 모든 생물이 나의 것이요, \q 천 개의 언덕 위의 가축도 [그렇기] 때문이다.
ko.B: 숲속의 모든 짐승이 다 내 것이요, \q 수많은 언덕에서 풀을 뜯는 가축도 다 내 것이다.
ko.R: 숲속의 모든 들짐승이 내 것이다. \q 수천 개의 언덕 위에 있는 소들도 내 것이다.

pt.L: Pois {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} [é] toda criatura viva da floresta, \q o gado sobre mil colinas.
pt.B: Pois todos os animais do bosque pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, \q e também os rebanhos que pastam sobre mil colinas.
pt.R: Todos os animais selvagens da floresta pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q O gado de milhares de colinas também.

am.L: የዱር እንስሳ ሁሉ፣ በሺህ ኮረብቶች ላይ \q ያሉ ከብቶችም የእኔ ናቸውና።
am.B: የጫካ ፍጥረታት ሁሉ የእኔ ናቸውና፤ \q በሺህ ኮረብቶች ላይ የሚሰማሩ መንጎችም እንዲሁ።
am.R: በጫካ ያሉ የዱር አራዊት ሁሉ የእኔ ናቸው። \q በብዙ ሺህ ኮረብቶች ላይ ያሉ ከብቶችም የእኔ ናቸው።

hi.L: क्योंकि वन का हर जीव मेरा [है], \q हज़ार पहाड़ियों पर के पशु [भी]।
hi.B: क्योंकि जंगल के सब प्राणी मेरे हैं, \q और हज़ार पहाड़ियों पर चरनेवाले ढोर भी।
hi.R: जंगल के सब जंगली पशु मेरे हैं। \q हज़ारों पहाड़ियों पर के मवेशी भी मेरे हैं।

ru.L: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} всякий зверь леса, \q скот на тысяче холмов.
ru.B: Ведь все лесные звери принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}, как и стада, \q пасущиеся на тысяче холмов.
ru.R: Все дикие звери в лесу принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}. \q И скот на тысячах холмов тоже.

ja.L: まことに、森のすべての生き物は、わたしのもの。 \q 千の丘の家畜も。
ja.B: 森のすべての生き物は、わたしのものであり、千の丘で草をはむ家畜の群れも、 \q わたしのものだからだ。
ja.R: 森にいる野の動物は、みな、わたしのものだ。 \q 数えきれない丘にいる家畜も、わたしのものだ。

uk.L: Бо кожна жива істота лісу — {{deity_pronoun:моя|Моя}}, \q худоба на тисячі пагорбів.
uk.B: Бо всі звірі лісу належать {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}, так само й череди, \q що пасуться на тисячі пагорбів.
uk.R: Усі дикі звірі в лісі належать {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}. \q Так само й худоба на тисячах пагорбів.

id.L: Sebab segala binatang hutan [adalah] milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, \q ternak di seribu bukit.
id.B: Sebab segala makhluk di hutan adalah milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, \q dan begitu juga ternak yang merumput di seribu bukit.
id.R: Semua binatang liar di hutan adalah milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}. \q Begitu juga ternak di ribuan bukit.

decisions.choice: to me belongs: God owns all creatures
decisions.reason: Everything people could offer already belongs to God (24:1). A gift cannot make him richer.

decisions.choice: a thousand hills: countless hills
decisions.reason: A thousand stands for a great, uncounted number.

decisions.choice: "千の丘" (L, B), "数えきれない丘" (R)
decisions.reason: A thousand hills are countless hills (m2).

source.text: יָ֭דַעְתִּי כָּל־ע֣וֹף הָרִ֑ים וְזִ֥יז שָׂ֝דַ֗י עִמָּדִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I know every bird of [the] mountains, and [the] moving creatures of [the] field [are] with me.

en.L: I know every bird of [the] mountains, \q and the moving creatures of [the] field [are] with {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.B: I know every bird of the high hills; \q whatever stirs in the open country is in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} keeping.
en.R: I know every bird that lives on the mountains. \q All the creatures in the fields belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

fr.L: Je connais tout oiseau des montagnes, \q et ce qui remue dans les champs [est] avec {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.B: Je connais chaque oiseau des hauteurs ; \q tout ce qui bouge dans la campagne est sous {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} garde.
fr.R: Je connais chaque oiseau qui vit dans les montagnes. \q Toutes les bêtes des champs {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartiennent.

sw.L: Ninamjua kila ndege wa milimani, \q na viumbe vinavyotembea mashambani [viko] {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}.
sw.B: Ninawajua ndege wote wa vilima virefu; \q kila kinachotembea porini kiko mikononi {{deity_pronoun:mwangu|Mwangu}}.
sw.R: Ninamjua kila ndege anayeishi milimani. \q Viumbe vyote vya mashambani ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

es.L: Conozco toda ave de [los] montes, \q y las criaturas que se mueven en [el] campo [están] conmigo.
es.B: Conozco cada ave de los altos montes; \q todo lo que se mueve en el campo está a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} cuidado.
es.R: Conozco cada pájaro que vive en los montes. \q Todas las criaturas del campo {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pertenecen.

vi.L: Ta biết mọi loài chim trên núi, \q và các loài động vật trong đồng [ở] với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Ta biết mọi loài chim trên các núi cao; \q mọi vật nhúc nhích ngoài đồng đều ở trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Ta biết mọi loài chim sống trên núi. \q Mọi sinh vật ngoài đồng đều thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 나는 산들의 모든 새를 알고, \q 들에서 움직이는 것들도 나와 함께 [있다].
ko.B: 높은 산의 새들을 내가 다 알고, \q 들판에서 움직이는 것들도 다 내 손안에 있다.
ko.R: 나는 산에 사는 새를 다 안다. \q 들판의 모든 생물도 다 내 것이다.

pt.L: Conheço toda ave dos montes, \q e as criaturas que se movem no campo [estão] {{deity_pronoun:comigo|Comigo}}.
pt.B: Conheço todas as aves dos altos montes; \q tudo o que se move em campo aberto está sob o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} cuidado.
pt.R: Conheço cada pássaro que vive nas montanhas. \q Todos os animais dos campos pertencem a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

am.L: የተራሮችን ወፎች ሁሉ አውቃለሁ፤ \q በሜዳ የሚንቀሳቀሱትም ከእኔ ጋር [ናቸው]።
am.B: በከፍታ ኮረብቶች ያሉትን ወፎች ሁሉ አውቃለሁ፤ \q በሜዳ የሚንቀሳቀስ ሁሉ በእጄ ነው።
am.R: በተራሮች ላይ የሚኖሩትን ወፎች ሁሉ አውቃለሁ። \q በሜዳ ያሉ ፍጥረታት ሁሉ የእኔ ናቸው።

hi.L: मैं पहाड़ों के सब पक्षियों को जानता हूँ, \q और मैदान के चलनेवाले जन्तु मेरे पास [हैं]।
hi.B: मैं ऊँचे पहाड़ों के हर पक्षी को जानता हूँ; \q खुले मैदान में जो कुछ चलता-फिरता है, वह मेरी देखरेख में है।
hi.R: मैं पहाड़ों पर रहनेवाले हर पक्षी को जानता हूँ। \q मैदानों के सब जीव-जन्तु मेरे हैं।

ru.L: Знаю {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} всякую птицу гор, \q и движущееся в поле — со {{deity_pronoun:мной|Мной}}.
ru.B: Я знаю каждую птицу на высоких холмах; \q всё, что движется в поле, — в {{deity_pronoun:моём|Моём}} ведении.
ru.R: Я знаю каждую птицу, которая живёт в горах. \q Все существа в полях принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}.

ja.L: わたしは、山々のすべての鳥を知っている。 \q 野にうごめくものも、わたしと共に[ある]。
ja.B: わたしは、高い山々のすべての鳥を知っている。 \q 野でうごめくものも、わたしの手の内にある。
ja.R: わたしは、山に住む鳥を一羽残らず知っている。 \q 野にいる生き物も、みな、わたしのものだ。

uk.L: Я знаю кожного птаха гір, і те, \q що рухається в полі, — зі {{deity_pronoun:мною|Мною}}.
uk.B: Я знаю кожного птаха високих пагорбів; \q усе, що ворушиться в полі, — під {{deity_pronoun:моєю|Моєю}} опікою.
uk.R: Я знаю кожного птаха, що живе в горах. \q Усі створіння в полях належать {{deity_pronoun:мені|Мені}}.

id.L: Aku mengenal segala burung di gunung-gunung, \q dan binatang-binatang yang bergerak di padang [ada] pada-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.
id.B: Aku mengenal setiap burung di bukit-bukit yang tinggi; \q segala yang bergerak di padang ada dalam pemeliharaan-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.
id.R: Aku mengenal setiap burung yang tinggal di gunung-gunung. \q Semua makhluk di padang adalah milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.

decisions.choice: moving creatures: the small creatures that swarm
decisions.reason: The word (ziz) is rare (80:14); it seems to mean whatever moves about in the fields, small animals or insects.

decisions.choice: I know: I know them as their owner
decisions.reason: To know them is to know each one as its owner and maker.

decisions.choice: with me: in my keeping, mine
decisions.reason: "With me" means they are present to him and under his care.

decisions.choice: ziz sadai "野にうごめくもの" (L, B), "野にいる生き物" (R); 'immadi "わたしと共に[ある]" (L), "わたしの手の内にある" (B)
decisions.reason: The small creatures that swarm (m1, uncertain); "with me" is in my keeping, mine (m3).

source.text: אִם־אֶ֭רְעַב לֹא־אֹ֣מַר לָ֑ךְ כִּי־לִ֥י תֵ֝בֵ֗ל וּמְלֹאָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: If I were hungry, not I would tell you, for to me [belongs the] world and its fullness.

en.L: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, \q for the world [is] {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}, and all that fills it.
en.B: Were I ever hungry, you are not the one I would tell, \q since the world and all it holds are {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}.
en.R: Even if I were hungry, I would not ask you for food. \q The whole world and everything in it is {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}.

fr.L: Si j’avais faim, je ne te le dirais pas, \q car le monde [est] à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et tout ce qui le remplit.
fr.B: Si jamais j’avais faim, ce n’est pas à toi que je le dirais, \q puisque le monde et tout ce qu’il contient sont à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: Même si j’avais faim, je ne te demanderais pas à manger. \q Le monde entier et tout ce qu’il contient sont à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Kama ningekuwa na njaa, nisingekuambia, \q kwa maana ulimwengu [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, na vyote vinavyoujaza.
sw.B: Hata kama ningeona njaa, wewe si yule ningemwambia, \q kwa kuwa ulimwengu na vyote vilivyomo ni {{deity_pronoun:vyangu|Vyangu}}.
sw.R: Hata kama ningekuwa na njaa, nisingekuomba chakula. \q Ulimwengu wote na kila kitu kilichomo ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

es.L: Si tuviera hambre, no te lo diría, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}} [es] el mundo, y todo lo que lo llena.
es.B: Si alguna vez tuviera hambre, no sería a ti a quien se lo diría, \q porque el mundo y todo lo que contiene son {{deity_pronoun:míos|Míos}}.
es.R: Aunque tuviera hambre, no te pediría comida. \q El mundo entero y todo lo que hay en él es {{deity_pronoun:mío|Mío}}.

vi.L: Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đói, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không nói với các con, \q vì thế gian [là] của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và mọi vật đầy dẫy trong đó.
vi.B: Dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có đói, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng chẳng nói với các con, \q vì thế gian và mọi vật trong đó đều là của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} có đói, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng không xin các con thức ăn. \q Cả thế giới và mọi vật trong đó đều là của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 내가 배고프다 해도 너에게 말하지 않을 것이다. \q 이는 세상과 그 안에 가득한 것이 나의 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 내가 배고프다 해도 너에게 말하지는 않을 것이다. \q 세상과 그 안에 있는 모든 것이 내 것이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 내가 배가 고프다 해도 너에게 먹을 것을 달라고 하지 않을 것이다. \q 온 세상과 그 안에 있는 모든 것이 내 것이다.

pt.L: Se eu tivesse fome, não te diria, \q pois {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} [é] o mundo e tudo o que o enche.
pt.B: Se algum dia eu tivesse fome, não seria a ti que eu diria, \q pois o mundo e tudo o que nele existe são {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}}.
pt.R: Mesmo que eu tivesse fome, não te pediria comida. \q O mundo inteiro e tudo o que há nele é {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}}.

am.L: ብራብ ለአንተ አልነግርህም፤ \q ዓለምና ሞላዋ የእኔ ናቸውና።
am.B: ብራብ እንኳ የምነግረው አንተን አይደለም፤ \q ዓለምና በውስጧ ያለው ሁሉ የእኔ ነውና።
am.R: ብራብ እንኳ ምግብ እንድትሰጠኝ አልለምንህም። \q ዓለም ሁሉና በውስጧ ያለው ሁሉ የእኔ ነው።

hi.L: यदि मुझे भूख लगती, तो मैं तुम्हें न बताता, \q क्योंकि संसार मेरा [है], और वह सब जो उसे भरता है।
hi.B: यदि मैं कभी भूखा होता, तो तुम वह नहीं हो जिससे मैं कहता, \q क्योंकि संसार और उसमें जो कुछ है, सब मेरा है।
hi.R: यदि मुझे भूख लगती, तब भी मैं तुमसे भोजन न माँगता। \q सारा संसार और उसमें की हर वस्तु मेरी है।

ru.L: Если бы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} проголодался, не сказал бы тебе, \q ведь {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} мир и всё, что наполняет его.
ru.B: Даже если бы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} когда-нибудь проголодался, не тебе {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сказал бы об этом, \q ведь мир и всё, что в нём, принадлежит {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}.
ru.R: Даже если бы {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} был голоден, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не стал бы просить у тебя еды. \q Весь мир и всё, что в нём, — {{deity_pronoun:моё|Моё}}.

ja.L: もし、わたしが飢えても、あなたに告げはしない。 \q まことに、世界とそれを満たすものは、わたしのもの。
ja.B: たとえわたしが飢えることがあっても、あなたに告げることはない。 \q 世界とそこに満ちるものはみな、わたしのものだからだ。
ja.R: たとえ、わたしが飢えたとしても、あなたに食べ物を求めたりはしない。 \q 全世界と、その中にあるすべてのものは、わたしのものだ。

uk.L: Якби я зголоднів, я не сказав би тобі, \q бо світ — {{deity_pronoun:мій|Мій}}, і все, що його сповнює.
uk.B: Якби я колись зголоднів, то не тобі я сказав би, \q бо світ і все, що в ньому, — {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}}.
uk.R: Навіть якби я був голодний, я не просив би в тебе їжі. \q Увесь світ і все, що в ньому, — {{deity_pronoun:моє|Моє}}.

id.L: Jika {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} lapar, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} tidak akan mengatakannya kepadamu, \q sebab dunia [adalah] milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}, dan segala isinya.
id.B: Seandainya {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} lapar, bukan kepadamu {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} akan memberitahukannya, \q sebab dunia dan segala isinya adalah milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.
id.R: Bahkan kalau {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} lapar, {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} tidak akan meminta makanan kepadamu. \q Seluruh dunia dan segala sesuatu di dalamnya adalah milik-{{deity_pronoun:ku|Ku}}.

decisions.choice: the world and its fullness
decisions.reason: The same words open 24:1: "The earth is the LORD's and its fullness".

decisions.choice: If I were hungry: God needs no food
decisions.reason: Israel's neighbors set out food for their gods. God mocks the idea that his sacrifices feed him.

decisions.choice: ask you for food
decisions.reason: Readable says what telling would be for.

decisions.choice: tevel umelo'ah "世界とそれを満たすもの" (L), "世界とそこに満ちるもの" (B)
decisions.reason: The world and its fullness (m1), as 24:1 (PSA-3) and 1 Corinthians 10:26.

source.text: הַֽ֭אוֹכַל בְּשַׂ֣ר אַבִּירִ֑ים וְדַ֖ם עַתּוּדִ֣ים אֶשְׁתֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Do I eat [the] flesh of mighty [bulls], and [the] blood of goats do I drink?

en.L: Do I eat the flesh of mighty [bulls], \q or drink the blood of goats?
en.B: Am I one who eats the meat of bulls, \q or drinks the blood of goats?
en.R: I do not feed on bulls' meat, \q and I do not drink goats' blood!

fr.L: Est-ce que je mange la chair des puissants [taureaux], \q ou bois le sang des boucs ?
fr.B: Suis-je quelqu’un qui mange la viande des taureaux, \q ou qui boit le sang des boucs ?
fr.R: Je ne me nourris pas de viande de taureau, \q et je ne bois pas de sang de bouc !

sw.L: Je, ninakula nyama ya [mafahali] wenye nguvu, \q au kunywa damu ya mbuzi?
sw.B: Je, mimi ni mmoja anayekula nyama ya mafahali, \q au kunywa damu ya mbuzi?
sw.R: Mimi sili nyama ya mafahali, \q wala sinywi damu ya mbuzi!

es.L: ¿Acaso como yo la carne de [toros] poderosos, \q o bebo la sangre de machos cabríos?
es.B: ¿Soy yo de los que comen carne de toros, \q o beben sangre de machos cabríos?
es.R: ¡Yo no me alimento de carne de toro, \q ni bebo sangre de cabra!

vi.L: Ta có ăn thịt của những [con bò] mạnh mẽ, \q hay uống máu của dê đực chăng?
vi.B: Ta có phải là Đấng ăn thịt bò đực, \q hay uống máu dê đực sao?
vi.R: Ta không ăn thịt bò, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} không uống máu dê!

ko.L: 내가 힘센 [소들의] 고기를 먹겠느냐, \q 숫염소들의 피를 마시겠느냐?
ko.B: 내가 황소의 고기를 먹고 \q 숫염소의 피를 마시는 자이겠느냐?
ko.R: 나는 소고기를 먹고 사는 것도 아니고, \q 염소의 피를 마시는 것도 아니다!

pt.L: Acaso como eu a carne de [touros] poderosos, \q ou bebo o sangue de bodes?
pt.B: Sou eu alguém que come carne de touros \q ou bebe sangue de bodes?
pt.R: Eu não me alimento de carne de touro \q e não bebo sangue de bode!

am.L: የብርቱዎችን [በሬዎች] ሥጋ እበላለሁን? \q ወይስ የፍየሎችን ደም እጠጣለሁን?
am.B: የበሬዎችን ሥጋ የምበላ፣ \q ወይስ የፍየሎችን ደም የምጠጣ ነኝን?
am.R: እኔ የበሬ ሥጋ አልመገብም፤ \q የፍየል ደምም አልጠጣም!

hi.L: क्या मैं बलवंत [बैलों] का मांस खाता हूँ, \q या बकरों का लहू पीता हूँ?
hi.B: क्या मैं बैलों का मांस खानेवाला हूँ, \q या बकरों का लहू पीनेवाला?
hi.R: मैं बैलों का मांस नहीं खाता, \q और न बकरों का लहू पीता हूँ!

ru.L: Разве {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ем мясо могучих [быков] \q и пью кровь козлов?
ru.B: Разве {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} ем мясо быков \q или пью кровь козлов?
ru.R: Я не питаюсь мясом быков \q и не пью кровь козлов!

ja.L: わたしが力ある[雄牛]の肉を食べ、 \q 雄やぎの血を飲むだろうか？
ja.B: わたしが、雄牛の肉を食べたり、 \q 雄やぎの血を飲んだりする者だろうか？
ja.R: わたしは、牛の肉を食べたりしない。 \q やぎの血を飲んだりもしない！

uk.L: Хіба я їм мʼясо могутніх [биків] \q чи пʼю кров козлів?
uk.B: Хіба я той, хто їсть мʼясо биків \q чи пʼє кров козлів?
uk.R: Я не живлюся мʼясом биків \q і не пʼю крові козлів!

id.L: Apakah {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} memakan daging lembu-lembu jantan, \q atau meminum darah kambing-kambing jantan?
id.B: Apakah {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} ini makan daging lembu jantan, \q atau minum darah kambing jantan?
id.R: Aku tidak makan daging sapi jantan, \q dan {{deity_pronoun:aku|Aku}} tidak minum darah kambing!

decisions.choice: mighty ones: bulls
decisions.reason: The word ('abbirim) means "mighty ones" and is used for strong bulls (22:13).

decisions.choice: a question that expects "no"
decisions.reason: The question mocks the idea that God feeds on sacrifices.

decisions.choice: a statement
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into what it means (m2).

decisions.choice: 'abbirim "力ある[雄牛]" (L), "雄牛" (B), "牛" (R); a question (L, B), a statement (R) as the English
decisions.reason: Mighty ones are bulls (m1); a question that expects "no" (m2).

source.text: זְבַ֣ח לֵאלֹהִ֣ים תּוֹדָ֑ה וְשַׁלֵּ֖ם לְעֶלְי֣וֹן נְדָרֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sacrifice to God thanksgiving, and pay to [the] Most High your vows,

en.L: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, \q and pay your vows to [the] Most High,
en.B: Offer thanksgiving to God as your sacrifice, \q and keep the vows you made to the Most High,
en.R: Instead, give thanks to God; let that be your sacrifice. \q Do what you promised the God who is above all.

fr.L: Sacrifie à Dieu une offrande de reconnaissance, \q et accomplis tes vœux envers [le] Très-Haut,
fr.B: Offre à Dieu la reconnaissance comme sacrifice, \q et tiens les vœux que tu as faits au Très-Haut,
fr.R: Remercie plutôt Dieu ; que ce soit là ton sacrifice. \q Fais ce que tu as promis au Dieu qui est au-dessus de tout.

sw.L: Mtolee Mungu sadaka ya shukrani, \q na umlipe Aliye Juu Kabisa nadhiri zako,
sw.B: Mtolee Mungu shukrani kama dhabihu yako, \q na utimize nadhiri ulizomwekea Aliye Juu Kabisa,
sw.R: Badala yake, mshukuru Mungu; hiyo iwe dhabihu yako. \q Fanya yale uliyomwahidi Mungu aliye juu ya vyote.

es.L: Ofrece a Dios sacrificio de acción de gracias, \q y cumple tus votos al Altísimo,
es.B: Ofrece a Dios la acción de gracias como tu sacrificio, \q y cumple los votos que hiciste al Altísimo,
es.R: Más bien, dale gracias a Dios; que ese sea tu sacrificio. \q Haz lo que le prometiste al Dios que está por encima de todo.

vi.L: Hãy dâng sự cảm tạ làm của lễ cho Đức Chúa Trời, \q và trả các lời khấn nguyện của các con cho Đấng Chí Cao,
vi.B: Hãy dâng lời cảm tạ làm của lễ cho Đức Chúa Trời, \q và giữ trọn những lời khấn nguyện các con đã hứa với Đấng Chí Cao,
vi.R: Thay vào đó, hãy cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời; hãy để điều đó là của lễ của các con. \q Hãy làm điều các con đã hứa với Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cao hơn mọi sự.

ko.L: 하나님께 감사의 제사를 드리고, \q 지극히 높으신 분께 네 서원들을 갚아라.
ko.B: 감사를 하나님께 제물로 바치고, \q 지극히 높으신 분께 한 서원을 지켜라.
ko.R: 오히려 하나님께 감사를 드려라. 그것이 네가 바칠 제물이 되게 하여라. \q 모든 것 위에 계신 하나님께 약속한 것을 지켜라.

pt.L: Oferece a Deus sacrifício de ação de graças, \q e paga ao Altíssimo os teus votos,
pt.B: Oferece a Deus gratidão como o teu sacrifício, \q e cumpre os votos que fizeste ao Altíssimo,
pt.R: Em vez disso, agradece a Deus; que esse seja o teu sacrifício. \q Cumpre o que prometeste ao Deus que está acima de tudo.

am.L: ለእግዚአብሔር የምስጋና መሥዋዕት ሠዋ፤ \q ለልዑልም ስእለትህን ፈጽም፤
am.B: ምስጋናን ለእግዚአብሔር መሥዋዕት አድርገህ አቅርብ፤ \q ለልዑልም የተሳልከውን ስእለት ፈጽም፤
am.R: ይልቁንም እግዚአብሔርን አመስግን፤ ይህም መሥዋዕትህ ይሁን። \q ከሁሉ በላይ ለሆነው አምላክ የገባኸውን ቃል ፈጽም።

hi.L: परमेश्वर को धन्यवाद-बलि चढ़ाओ, \q और परमप्रधान के लिए अपनी मन्नतें पूरी करो,
hi.B: धन्यवाद को अपना बलिदान बनाकर परमेश्वर को चढ़ाओ, \q और जो मन्नतें तुमने परमप्रधान से मानी हैं, उन्हें पूरा करो,
hi.R: इसके बदले, परमेश्वर का धन्यवाद करो; यही तुम्हारा बलिदान हो। \q जो वादे तुमने उन परमेश्वर से किए जो सबसे ऊपर हैं, उन्हें पूरा करो।

ru.L: Принеси Богу в жертву благодарение \q и исполни Всевышнему обеты твои,
ru.B: Принеси Богу благодарность как свою жертву \q и исполни обеты, которые ты дал Всевышнему,
ru.R: Лучше благодари Бога — пусть это будет твоей жертвой. \q Делай то, что ты обещал Богу, который выше всех.

ja.L: 神に感謝のいけにえをささげ、 \q いと高き方に、あなたの誓いを果たしなさい。
ja.B: 感謝を、神へのいけにえとしてささげなさい。 \q いと高き方に立てた誓いを、果たしなさい。
ja.R: それよりも、神に感謝しなさい。それを、あなたのささげ物としなさい。 \q すべてのものの上に立つ神に約束したことを、果たしなさい。

uk.L: Принось Богові подячну жертву \q і виконуй свої обітниці Всевишньому,
uk.B: Приноси Богові подяку як свою жертву \q і виконуй обітниці, які ти дав Всевишньому,
uk.R: Натомість дякуй Богові; нехай це буде твоєю жертвою. \q Зроби те, що ти пообіцяв Богові, який вищий за все.

id.L: Persembahkanlah syukur sebagai korban kepada Allah, \q dan bayarlah nazar-nazarmu kepada Yang Mahatinggi,
id.B: Persembahkanlah ucapan syukur kepada Allah sebagai korbanmu, \q dan tepatilah nazar-nazar yang kauucapkan kepada Yang Mahatinggi,
id.R: Sebaliknya, bersyukurlah kepada Allah; biarlah itu menjadi korbanmu. \q Lakukanlah apa yang telah kaujanjikan kepada Allah yang di atas segala sesuatu.

decisions.choice: thanksgiving: a thank offering, or thanks itself
decisions.reason: The word (todah) is both the thank offering (Leviticus 7:12) and the thanks it expresses. What God wants is the grateful heart, given with or as the sacrifice (compare 51:18-19; Hebrews 13:15).

decisions.choice: pay your vows: do what you promised God
decisions.reason: A vow was a promise to God, often of an offering, made in time of need (Deuteronomy 23; 66:13-14).

decisions.choice: God speaks of himself as "God"
decisions.reason: God names himself in the third person, "God", "the Most High", as a king might in a royal decree; the speaker is still God.

decisions.choice: the God who is above all
decisions.reason: As in 46:5.

decisions.choice: thanksgiving (todah) as "የምስጋና መሥዋዕት" (Literal), "ምስጋናን … መሥዋዕት አድርገህ" (Balanced); vow "ስእለት"
decisions.reason: The word is both the thank offering of Leviticus 7:12 ("የምስጋና መሥዋዕት" on main) and the thanks itself (see the meaning decision); Literal names the offering, Balanced the thanks offered as it, as the English levels do. Verse 23 follows the same pattern.

decisions.choice: "Всевышний" (L, B); "Богу, который выше всех" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 46:5.

decisions.choice: zevach todah "感謝のいけにえ" (L), "感謝を…いけにえとして" (B), "感謝しなさい。それを…ささげ物と" (R); 'Elyon "いと高き方" (L, B), "すべてのものの上に立つ神" (R)
alternatives: すべてのものの上におられる神
decisions.reason: A thank offering, or thanks itself (m1). God speaks of himself as God (m3), so Readable says "上に立つ神", not the usual "上におられる神", which would put a respect form in God's own mouth.

source.text: וּ֭קְרָאֵנִי בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלֶּצְךָ֗ וּֽתְכַבְּדֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: and call on me in [a] day of trouble; I will rescue you, and you will honor me.

en.L: and call on {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} in [the] day of trouble; \q I will rescue you, and you will honor {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."
en.B: and call to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} when trouble comes; \q I will set you free, and you will give {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} glory."
en.R: When you are in trouble, call to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for help. \q I will save you, and you will praise {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}."

fr.L: et invoque-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} au jour de la détresse ; \q je te délivrerai, et tu {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}honoreras. »
fr.B: et appelle-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} quand vient la détresse ; \q je te libérerai, et tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} rendras gloire. »
fr.R: Quand tu es dans le malheur, appelle-{{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} au secours. \q Je te sauverai, et tu {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} loueras. »

sw.L: na uniite {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} siku ya taabu; \q nitakuokoa, nawe utaniheshimu."
sw.B: na uniite wakati shida zinapokuja; \q nitakuweka huru, nawe utanipa utukufu."
sw.R: Unapokuwa katika shida, niite nikusaidie. \q Nitakuokoa, nawe utanisifu."

es.L: y a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} clama en [el] día de la angustia; \q yo te libraré, y tú {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} honrarás.»
